summary: Lists the url lookup's options for TLS (ca_path, ciphers), redirects, caching, basic auth, headers, user agent, credentials, line splitting, timeout, unix sockets and unredirected headers.
questions: How do I send custom HTTP headers with the url lookup?
How do I point the url lookup at a custom CA bundle?
How can I get the whole response as one string instead of a list of lines?
What is the default timeout for the url lookup and how do I change it?
How do I authenticate to a password-protected URL with the url lookup?
Can the url lookup connect over a unix socket?
How do I control redirect following in the url lookup?

answer_card.title: url lookup options (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
Key options:
- `headers` (dict): HTTP request headers
- `username` / `password`: HTTP auth; `force_basic_auth: true` to send basic auth upfront
- `ca_path`: CA bundle path; `ciphers`: list of TLS ciphers (joined with `:`)
- `follow_redirects`: `all`, `none`, `safe`, `urllib2` (default `urllib2`)
- `force`: send `cache-control: no-cache` (default false)
- `http_agent`: User-Agent (default `ansible-httpget`)
- `split_lines` (default true): set false to get a single text blob
- `timeout` (default 10 seconds)
- `unix_socket`: connect via a unix socket
- `unredirected_headers`: headers not to send on redirects
